items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: My daddy was a musician, my brother, my brother-in-law. All of them, all in one house.

ctx.x: Did you have any musicians in your family?

My daddy, sure. That's how we love him. But when the professor, Professor Hinger, white man, would be teaching, I'd be at that winter. I'd be at that winter and let everything he tell my daddy do. My daddy was a musician, my brother, my brother-in-law. All of them, all in one house. All of them was in the same house. My brother-in-law played the bass, bass violin, you know? My brother, he played the bass, tuba. My brother played the tuba. My daddy was a drummer. My dear I remember the name, yeah. But anyhow, they…
Did you have them play any other instruments?
